measured.scale_note: the printed 125 µm centre between the post rows' tip lines (gifford_fig6_measurement.json)

end_check.rule: the last pill (image) and the last post (mask) are each followed, one gap downstream, by the divider wall and by no further post

leg7.caption: Gifford et al. 2014 Lab Chip 14, 4496–4505, Fig. 6 (the micrograph; scale from the printed 125 µm centre, 4.5248 µm/px; the rows at 49.81° on the image) with gifford2014_fig6_design: the end of leg 7 (the image's top leg; cyan: the reproduction claim, its posts, channels and walls to 60 µm into the divider wall that starts one gap after the last post; amber: the turn or outlet stretch beyond).  Registration: scale and rotation from the printed centre width and the rows on the image, rotation measured on the image; translation fitted on features and, independently, by chamfer matching (they agree within 0.0 / 0.4 px along / across).  Nearest-outline offset: median 1.88 µm, 90th percentile 4.31 µm (n 2221); for comparison 5.83 µm with the mask shifted half a pitch along and 2.46 µm with it shifted 5 µm across.  On the image: side channels at the leg's end upper side 145.5 µm (mask 139.9).  END_CHECK (the along-flow pairing): on the upper row the last pill stands 16.7 µm and the mask's last post 20.5 µm before the divider wall, no further post beyond (holds).  The centre (the scale), the pitch and the post length were measured on this micrograph: their agreement is consistency.
